label: ext.blocktype ext.uicontribution
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.uicontribution

properties.component: route and panel kinds: a source path within the same extension
properties.id: the contribution id, equal to its contributions/<id>.json file name; the materializer commit path refuses a contribution file whose content id differs
properties.slot: panel kind: the panel slot contributed into
properties.title: command kind: the command title

createParameters.semantics: Declares UI surface consumed by the shell's build-time registry. Materializes to src/extensions/<extId>/contributions/<id>.json — one file per Block, so the materializer lockfile maps each file to one (blockId, version).
